system: Classify the epistemic status of the TARGET claim using only the supplied record. recorded: stored instrument signal; reconstructed: quantity extracted from signals by calibration or reduction; model_inferred: physical state inferred by matching data to a chosen physical model; unresolved: causal or physical claim not distinguished by the available evidence. A caption or author's assertion cannot upgrade evidence. Return exactly one label: recorded, reconstructed, model_inferred, unresolved.
limitations: Author-constructed labels; no independent annotation; family variants are dependent; public after this run.

planned_training.success: Positive paired test accuracy difference with per-family reporting; descriptive only, no certification
